content.text:
You can sign in to **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)** here:

**Official MSCA sign-in page:** ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

On the page, choose one of these login options:

1. **Interac Sign-In Partner** — use your online banking login  
2. **GCKey** — use your Government of Canada username/password  
3. **Provincial sign-in** — available for **BC** and **Alberta** residents only ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/province.html?utm_source=openai))

If you don’t have an account yet, use the official **Create My Service Canada Account** page. You must be at least **12 years old**, and you must create/use the account only for yourself. ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/registration.html?utm_source=openai))

**Security tip:** Don’t use links from texts/emails. Go through Canada.ca and make sure the address is a Government of Canada site before entering personal information.
